title: Timezone Map Finder: Zone for Any Point
description: Resolve any point on the map to its IANA timezone with the Timezone Map Finder — name and local offset context in one click. Free.
summary_sentence: For example, clicking either side of a state line in the US Midwest can flip the zone name under your cursor — the map makes the invisible border of time visible.
quick_answer: The Timezone Map Finder resolves any point to its IANA timezone name and local offset context. Click the map or search a place and read the zone identity — the authoritative-shaped answer (America/Chicago, Europe/Berlin) that software, calendars and conversions all ultimately need.
